name: drag mode still pans on hover
why: In drag mode only a drag moves the zoomed image; without the mode check the hover pans it as in follow mode.
grep: a hover leaves the zoomed image alone

name: the drag/pinch/anchor pan is not clamped
why: _artViewerPanAnchor() clamps like every pan; without it a long drag moves the image past the frame.

edits.find: st.pan = { x: o.x ? clamp(-tx / o.x) : 0, y: o.y ? clamp(-ty / o.y) : 0 };
edits.replace: st.pan = { x: o.x ? -tx / o.x : 0, y: o.y ? -ty / o.y : 0 };

grep: a hover leaves the zoomed image alone

name: the click a drag ends with toggles the zoom
why: A drag's own click must be swallowed, or every drag ends by fitting the image.
grep: a hover leaves the zoomed image alone

name: drag mode's wheel zooms about the centre
why: In drag mode the wheel keeps the image spot under the pointer in place (_artViewerPanAnchor with from = to).
grep: the wheel zooms keeping the image spot

name: 1:1 is not worked out again for the large image
why: 1 is pressed while the thumbnail shows; without the re-fit rule the large image keeps the thumbnail's 1:1 level and is shown at a sixth of its pixels.
grep: the readout is screen px per image px

name: the readout shows the fit-relative level
why: The readout is screen px per IMAGE px (level x fit factor); the bare level reads 100 % at fit whatever the image's size.
grep: the readout is screen px per image px

name: a quarter turn is fitted as if upright
why: At 90/270 degrees the image's width and height swap for the fit and the pan; fitted upright, the turned image overflows the frame.
grep: R turns a quarter turn

name: the turned and zoomed pan uses the upright size
why: Same defect, seen from the pan: the overhang worked out from the upright size over-pans the turned image.
grep: turned and zoomed

name: a step keeps the rotation
why: R turns one sideways scan; the next image starts upright.
grep: R turns a quarter turn

name: Esc closes the viewer while it is fullscreen
why: The first Esc leaves fullscreen and keeps the viewer open, where the browser lets the key through at all.
grep: F enters the browser

name: closing the viewer stays fullscreen
why: The overlay is the fullscreen element; closed without leaving fullscreen, the browser shows an empty black screen.
grep: F enters the browser

name: the background pick is not remembered
why: B writes {v, from} to MB_ART_VIEWER_BG_KEY; without it the next opening is dark again.
grep: B cycles dark, light and checker

name: a background pick outlives a setting change
why: The pick is honoured only while the setting still has the value it overrode (the _artCellLayout() rule).
grep: gives way once the setting is changed

name: the facts are never filled in
why: The image's load handler fills the Shown/Original lines once the natural size is known.
grep: facts: the rendition and pixel size

name: the facts setting is ignored
why: sa_art_viewer_facts off: no Shown/Original lines.
grep: with sa_art_viewer_facts off

name: a blob: image's size is not read
why: From the image cache the size and type are read locally from the blob: URL; nothing else knows them (Resource Timing has no sizes for the archive).
grep: facts from the image cache

name: a second D while one runs makes a second request
why: One request per press: st.dl guards the image whose original is being downloaded.
grep: D saves the original

name: the download name drops the comment
why: Art Station's <NN> <types> <comment>.<ext>.
grep: D saves the original

name: a pinch zooms about the centre
why: A pinch keeps the image spot under the fingers' midpoint in place; the test's midpoint is off-centre.

edits.find: _artViewerPanAnchor(st, p.s0, p.t0, p.m0, { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 });

grep: two fingers zoom about their midpoint

name: one finger on a zoomed image swipes instead of dragging
why: Zoomed, one finger drags the image; only unzoomed does it swipe to the next image.

edits.find:
st.swipeX = st.zoom ? null : e.clientX;
                if (st.zoom) _artViewerDragStart(st, stage, e);
